row_matrices.format: Original tagged mpf/mpc integer-word tuples, complete column-major matrices; no rounded conversion.
row_matrices.original_key_provenance: Opaque historical key; original private preimage is not exported, so old keys cannot be recomputed and the original three-file cache API is not supported.

scope_boundary: Only the first original native case projector matrices and prescribed full composite. This is not full optimizer, physical feasibility, convergence, original-paper-reference or full18/all-six acceptance. Transport checks are not new scientific validation.
row_generation_warning: New uncached rows were actually integrated at original80/100 precision; only final saved-row assembly and this data preparation used zero new integrals.
publication_status: Prepared locally; no GitHub upload claimed.

exact_matrix_object.definition: Pi_k = h_k h_k^H / ||h_k||^2; A = I - sum_k Pi_k; M_k = E[Pi_k].
exact_matrix_object.independent_NHU_identity: E[A A^H] = I - sum_k M_k + sum_{k!=j} M_k M_j. All ordered pairs are retained.
exact_matrix_object.assumptions: Per-sample rank-one projector idempotence and independence of different NHU channels.
not_claimed: A is an exact joint-nullspace orthogonal projector
full physical feasibility or final IEEE reference agreement
exact_matrix_object.interpretation: This second moment is exact under the stated model; it is not E[A], not the square of I-sum(M_k), and not a truncated Neumann series.
